asserts: A TypeScript recording carries the two facts a re-run is made of, and neither is a fact any other key already held (design §2.2): `refocus_of` is the run this one re-runs one flag deeper, written by the driver's `--refocus-of` before the harness was spawned, and `harness_cwd` is the directory the command was TYPED in -- a third directory beside the container's `cwd`, which for a vitest worker is wherever the pool started it, and the plan's `root`, because the harness command's relative arguments (`vitest run src/fail.test.ts`) are relative to neither of those and a re-run has to reproduce the one they ARE relative to. So `info` prints `harness cwd:` on the line under the harness line. The re-run's own report rides the generic block the Python and Rust recorders already write -- the verdict never travels alone, the licence rides with the verdict, and the checks that could not run are named rather than left to be inferred -- and `refocus_siblings` is stamped on the PAIR alone (A9), printed as `siblings in the re-run: 3 (not compared; UNVERIFIED)` because a vitest invocation's other containers were re-run beside this one and nothing compared them; `runs` flags the same member `refocus-of:<id>` and `verdict:MATCH(granted:1,see-info)` through that same generic path, because a TypeScript re-run is a re-run and not a fourth kind of thing.

refocus_licence_verified: identical call shape across 1 compared fingerprint(s), holding 2 causal event(s) outside any test

questions.ask: Where was this harness command typed, which run does this recording re-run, and what did the comparison of the two actually cover?
expect_contains: harness: npx vitest run src/fail.test.ts  exit: 1 (waited)
licence verified: identical call shape across 1 compared fingerprint(s), holding 2 causal event(s) outside any test
licence unverifiable: output (not recorded), children (not witnessed), threads (not witnessed)
siblings in the re-run: 3 (not compared; UNVERIFIED)
expect_absent: licence granted, but this trace does not record WHAT it was granted on

questions.ask: Does the listing say this trace is a re-run, of what, with which verdict, and over how many licensed points?
